blocks.html:
This method retrieves a sales channel. It sends a request to the
[Retrieve Sales Channel](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#sales-channels\_getsaleschannelsid)
API route.

types.name: id
types.description: The ID of the sales channel to retrieve.

types.name: query
types.description: Configure the fields and relations to retrieve in the sales channel.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#select-fields-and-relations).

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

children.name: is_disabled
children.description: Whether the sales channel is disabled.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Custom key-value pairs that can be added to the sales channel.

children.name: updated_at
children.description: The sales channel's last updated date.
